diagnosis.root_cause: An external DDoS attack against the external DNS provider (dyn-managed) overwhelmed their infrastructure, causing external DNS resolution failures which prevented users from reaching the site.
evidence: edge-monitor / external_dns_success_rate drop from first=0.9917 to last=0.5541
2026-12-11T12:00:00Z edge-monitor WARN external DNS resolution success for www.example.com down to 60% from multiple regions
2026-12-11T12:03:00Z edge-monitor ERROR DNS provider dyn-managed reports a large DDoS against its infrastructure since 11:58 UTC
2026-12-11T12:07:00Z edge-monitor INFO origin servers and internal DNS are healthy; failures are all at the external authoritative layer
2026-12-11T12:30:00Z edge-monitor INFO secondary DNS provider activated for critical zones; resolution success climbing back toward 99%
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Wait for the external DNS provider to mitigate the DDoS attack or continue routing traffic through the secondary DNS provider until the primary provider fully recovers.
